facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Toad was a rich animal. He loved new things. One day he saw a car. Toad loved cars.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Toad was the richest animal living by the river. He lived in a beautiful big house called Toad Hall. One day a motor car drove past him on the road. Toad loved cars from the very first moment he saw one. His eyes grew wide and he could not stop staring. He forgot about boats and horses and only wanted cars.
